result.title: MoCKEFA: Model-Conditioned Keyframe Extraction and Fair Attribution for Video Model Explanation
result.summary: We show that a video can be represented with just a few keyframes without sacrificing a given model's belief about the video. Our method is the first of its kind that extracts these keyframes conditioned on the model's prediction, which is massively helpful for building explainable video models. We then fairly distribute the importance of the video to the model among the keyframes with game theoretically fair Shapley values. Through qualitative and quantitative experiments, we show that keyframe attribution is superior to the traditional frame attribution. Further, we conduct preliminary exploration on highlighting the important changes among the frames by looking at the differences between adjacent keyframes.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MoCKEFA，以视频模型的预测为条件抽取少量关键帧，使模型对该视频的判断基本不变，并用 Shapley 值把视频的重要性公平分摊到关键帧上，通过定性与定量实验比较关键帧归因与传统逐帧归因，并初步探索相邻关键帧间的变化。
AI.relevance_reason: 「以模型预测为条件、用最少视觉证据维持模型判断」这一线索可能可供核查 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与信息充分性判断，Shapley 分摊也可能启发推理步与视觉输入的贡献分配；但该工作属视频模型可解释性，与多模态推理内部状态的联系需进一步确认。
